tools.name: integrity_paper_status
tools.description: Look up one paper by DOI or OpenAlex id and return its identity (title, year, venue) plus every retraction record the graph holds for it, each with its source and source tier: A is an official registry, B an authoritative index, C an aggregator. Use it to check whether a paper is retracted and which

tools.name: retraction_propagation
tools.description: Judge whether a retraction propagates to a paper through its citation graph: retraction evidence is weighted by source tier, the citing context is checked for an acknowledgement, and the tool returns CONTESTED, SUPPORTED or ABSTAINED with the evidence path behind the verdict. Use it after integrity_
